name: Render resolution 1280x720
description: The renderer's default settings ask for a 2560x1440 scene in a 3840x2160 output. This lowers the scene to 1280x720; the output size stays. Much lighter on the GPU.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: AnyPS5 fork (local build, 2026-11-11) and KytyPS5 fork 87de64e0: ~17 fps -> ~30 fps in the first gameplay scene on an RTX 3050 laptop GPU.
